verdict.rationale: Formant documents its own APIs and SDKs for driving devices. The Admin API can create custom commands, and built-in commands such as formant.publish_ros_topic and formant.run_script act on the robot. The Agent SDK receives and responds to commands on the device, a durable queue delivers requests when the device comes online, and the toolkit offers APIs plus a RealtimeSDK for custom apps. The evidence shows commands sent from the UI or triggered by events, though, and never documents scoped credentials or an end-to-end flow where an external agent issues commands through the API; no public OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: documented scoped/service-account credentials for programmatic access, explicit API/SDK method for issuing commands or teleop to a robot from an external client, published API spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of an AI agent controlling a robot end-to-end.
